notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Polyraptor.
description:
Deal damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of it.
The Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Empire's second ability and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Forerunner of the Empire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each creature.
Each Polyraptor you control triggers.
Resolve a Polyraptor trigger, creating a token copy of it.
Repeat from step 3.
